description: Sim 89 — CMSTG Planck TT likelihood comparison (Phase 5b). Uses CLASS C_ell from SIM88 (CMSTG and LCDM) with T_CMB^2 conversion, compared against the Planck 2018 best-fit TT theory spectrum (COM_PowerSpect_CMB-base-plikHM-TTTEEE R3.01) using the approximate full-sky Gaussian TT likelihood. Closes the remaining referee gap: prior simulations compared CMSTG vs LCDM without noise; this provides a proper chi2 vs Planck.

likelihood.note: f_sky=0.778 is the Planck 2018 plikHM TT effective sky fraction (Planck 2018 V, Table 1). Approximate Gaussian likelihood: chi2 = f_sky * sum_l (2l+1)/2 * [x - 1 - ln(x)] where x = C_l^pred / C_l^Planck. This is the exact likelihood in the full-sky cosmic-variance limit. Adds a conservative Planck noise floor: N_l = (Delta_T * theta_FWHM)^2 * exp(l(l+1)*sigma_b^2) to avoid noise bias at high l.

planck_noise.note: Planck 143 GHz approximate channel noise. Used as noise floor to prevent chi2 blow-up at l>1500 where signal is noise-dominated.

acceptance.note: CMSTG acceptable if chi2_CMSTG - chi2_LCDM < 100 (corresponds to ~10-sigma pull on combined CMB constraint). Typical acceptable tension: Delta_chi2 < 9 (3-sigma).
